title: Non-singular hotspots between closely spaced high-index nanoparticles
summary: We study the concentration of the field between two nearly touching high-index dielectric resonators in three dimensions. The model is a scalar Helmholtz transmission problem in the resonant regime, wherein the wavelength inside the resonators of the same order as their typical diameter. The material contrast enters only a lower-order term of the equation and not its principal part. As a consequence, the gradient of the field stays bounded independently of the distance separating the particles, and does not blow up.
